fomod.Name: Nemesis Combat AI
fomod.Author: GennyWoo
fomod.Description: Enemy nerve, morale and tactics from who they are and what is happening around them: a native SKSE plugin plus tiered combat styles for melee, Draugr, archers, Forsworn, bosses and mages. Detects For Honor, Dynamic Grip and NPC Spell Variance. Movesets stay with For Honor / BFCO. Replaces SkyTactics.
